Zelle · EVERFI

Financial concepts, grounded in everyday decisions.

Developed for Zelle and EVERFI, Money Moves uses character-led scenarios to introduce financial concepts. The public course was later renamed Modern Money.

ProjectZelle / Money Moves
Contribution / source recordProject-specific role to confirm.

Design approach

  • Account-balance scenarios combine dialogue, navigation and listening controls in a consistent lesson structure.
  • Mobile specifications reorder content and replace full character illustrations with compact avatars to preserve reading hierarchy.

Why this work matters

The design material shows responsive judgment at the level of content and interaction, beyond simply resizing a desktop screen.
